settings.title: Settings
settings.bookingOpenOff: Close booking? This stops all new bookings.
settings.automationHint: Control auto-confirm and auto-reminders from here.
settings.autoConfirm: Auto-confirm booking after customer marks transfer sent
settings.autoConfirmHint: When the customer taps “sent on WhatsApp”, the booking confirms itself. Turn off to review payments manually.
settings.autoRemindersHint: System messages the customer automatically. Needs WhatsApp Cloud API credentials below.
settings.reminderMinutesBefore: Remind how many minutes before? (60 = 1 hour)
settings.waReady: WhatsApp Cloud API configured — auto reminders are on.
settings.waNeeded: The access token is a secret key from Meta that lets WhatsApp send by itself. If empty: manual reminders still work, and in-app admin alerts still work.
settings.waHowTitle: How to get an Access Token (free to start)
settings.waHowBody:
1) Open developers.facebook.com and your WhatsApp Cloud API app.
2) From WhatsApp > API Setup copy the Phone number ID.
3) Create a Temporary access token (or a lasting System User token) and paste it here.
4) Save — reminders and booking confirmations can send automatically.
settings.manualRemindersOnly: Auto WhatsApp is off for now. Send from the Reminders tab manually via WhatsApp (free).
settings.vodafone: Vodafone Cash payment link (from Vodafone app)
settings.payLinkHint: Paste the full payment link from Vodafone or InstaPay — tapping opens the app
settings.customerUiHint: This is the text on the customer home screen: under the logo, big headline, support line, and the About section.
settings.customerUiSaveHint: After saving, hard-refresh the customer site (Ctrl+Shift+R) to see changes.
